```r
punctuality <- read.csv("punctuality.csv") # <1>
punctuality$gap <- punctuality$off_peak - punctuality$peak # <2>
punctuality[order(-punctuality$gap), ] # <3>
```
1. Read the on-time rates for each route.
2. Calculate the difference between off-peak and peak on-time rates.
3. Sort the routes so the largest gap is first.
